app.name: Wii Motion Synth
app.long_description:
A standalone Nintendo Wii homebrew application that turns your Wiimote into an interactive audio synthesizer.
Controls: - Pitch (Forward/Back): Adjusts Frequency (100Hz - 1000Hz) - Roll (Left/Right): Adjusts Amplitude/Volume - A Button: Sine Wave - B Button: Square Wave - 1 Button: Sawtooth Wave - HOME: Exit to Loader
